name: Red Pot
_comment: requiredLocales must be complete or the build fails. plannedLocales are the remaining launch languages (product plan section 2); they are translated shortly before the first release, together, exactly as the corpus is (app repository, ADR 0017). A locale is built only when every page exists in it -- half a language is worse than none, because the browser's fallback never fires for a language that appears to exist.

_underConstruction: One switch, two effects: it shows the banner on every page and adds <meta name="robots" content="noindex">. A site describing an app nobody can download yet should say so on the privacy and imprint pages too, not only on the front page -- those are the ones that look most like a finished product. And a half-written page indexed now outranks the finished one later. Set it to false on launch day; nothing else changes.
